title: New Look: Kitchen
body:
The Kitchen has been redecorated! A level ring shows your chef rank and what the next Kitchen level unlocks.
Recipes glow when you can cook them, show every ingredient you still need, and can be filtered into Meals and Gifts.
Your active meal shows a pip for each battle it has left, and you can tap a pantry ingredient to go where it drops.

title: New Look: Tower & Arena
body:
The Tower of Trials has a new climb view: a glowing path through every floor, Guardian floors marked in red and the gem reward on each floor.
Each floor now shows its battlefield, a THREAT meter (Favored, Even Fight, Risky, Deadly) and named enemy cards.
Arena now shows every Season Tier, its reward, and how many RP you need for the next one.

title: Quality of Life: Missions & Bag
body:
Missions now show an icon for each task, list ready rewards first and move finished ones to the bottom.
Tap any item in the Bag to see OBTAIN FROM: every place it drops or is sold, with a GO button.
Level-up and feature-unlock notices now merge into one message, and battle intro banners are slimmer so they no longer hide your heroes.

title: The Kitchen Opens!
body:
A new place to relax: the Kitchen (MENU → Heroes & Bond, Player Lv.3).
Collect Moonwheat Flour, Starberries, Dewleaf Herbs and Wild Game from story, Hard and Event battles, Garden visits, Herb Gathering and the free daily Market Basket.
Cook sweet dishes as gifts for your heroes, or serve a hearty meal to buff your whole team for the next few battles. Cook more to raise your Kitchen level and learn new recipes!

title: Redeem Codes & Battery Saver
body:
Redeem codes are here! Open Settings and enter EUPHORIA2026 for 500 Gems and 2 Summon Tickets. Each code works once.
Playing on a phone? Settings → Frame rate → 30 FPS keeps your device cooler and saves battery.

title: Mission GO Buttons
body:
Unfinished missions now have a GO button that takes you straight to the right place.
New daily mission: reply to a hero's message. New achievements: reply to 10 and 50 messages, and read 10 personal chats.
The Arena screen is tidier: season reward, tickets and buttons all fit on one screen, and ARENA SHOP now opens the Arena Shop tab.

title: Messenger: More Chats
body:
Heroes now text you when something happens: give one a gift, or win a story battle, and someone will message you about it (once a day each).
Every hero also has a second personal chat at Bond Lv.6, with another 30 Gems for the first reply.

title: Messenger
body:
Your heroes can text you now! Every day up to 3 heroes send you a message. Open CHATS in the lobby and pick a reply.
The reply she likes best gives +40 Bond, any other reply gives +20. At Bond Lv.2 every hero sends one personal chat that also gives 30 Gems.
The Bag now shows item names, and empty currencies are hidden.

title: New Item Icons
body:
Twelve items now have their own icons, so you can tell them apart at a glance.
Skin Tickets, Moonlight Perfume and Celestial Gems no longer look alike, potions no longer look like Hero EXP or Energy, and the Gold Pouch, Forge Ember, Hunt Core, Rune Pouch, Universal Shard and both gear and rune chests each have their own art.

title: Scout Report
body:
Know your enemy before you fight. Stage details now show the enemies' main element and which element to bring for +30% ATK.
In Formation, heroes that counter the enemy are marked, and AUTO takes the advantage into account.
Lost a battle? The result screen now tells you what to change, including which hero to bring.

title: Summon With Tickets and Gems
body:
Summon x10 now spends your Tickets first and covers the rest with Gems, so 5 Tickets plus 750 Gems is enough for a full 10x.
The Story screen is also tidier: Hard mode and later Arcs appear as you reach them.

title: First Steps
body:
New Commanders now get a guided path of 8 steps, shown in the NEXT box in the lobby. Each step pays a reward, ending with 2 Summon Tickets and 200 Gems for clearing Chapter 1.
Already past them? Your finished steps are waiting: just tap CLAIM.

title: Four Special Skins Withdrawn
body:
The special skins for Lucidria, Hyeonxa, Kali and Abadonia have been removed from the Wardrobe because their art was damaged.
If you unlocked one, you have received 1 Skin Ticket back for each, and the hero now wears her best unlocked outfit.
The skins of Ning Er, Spimei and Luby are not affected.

title: Gear Substats & Tempering
body:
Every piece of gear now rolls bonus substats: 1 on R, 2 on SR, 3 on SSR (HP, ATK, DEF or Crit). Your existing gear has already received its rolls.
Enhancing to +5 and +10 upgrades one random substat, and Fusing adds a new one.
New Forge tab, TEMPER: spend Forge Embers to reroll substats. Keep the ones you like (each doubles the cost) and compare the result before it applies, so a bad roll never costs you your old stats.

title: The Forge
body:
The Forge is open (Menu > Shop & Social, Player Lv.6).
REFORGE: spend Forge Embers to turn a piece into the set you want.  FUSE: 3 pieces of one rarity become the next rarity.  SALVAGE: clear spare gear in bulk for Gold and Embers. Equipped, locked and enhanced gear stays safe.
Armory Ruins now drops a guaranteed piece of Today's Set on every clear, plus Embers.
New on each hero's GEAR tab: WEAR SET equips a whole set in one tap, and AUTO EQUIP no longer breaks a set you are wearing.

title: Gear Sets
body:
Every piece of equipment now belongs to a set. Wear 2 pieces of a set for a stat bonus, 3 pieces for a battle effect:
Flame Pact — ATK +8% / skills also Burn.  Tidecaller — HP +10% / heal 6% every round.  Bastion — DEF +10% / start with a 15% Shield.  Gale Fang — Crit +6% / crits +30% damage.  Crimson Thirst — ATK & HP +5% / heal 12% of damage dealt.
Your existing gear already has a set — check the GEAR tab of each hero.

title: New skill effects
body: Skills now look different by their area: 2x2 skills rain meteors, cross / X skills cut with twin crescent slashes, melee strikes leave a slash arc, wide WIND / DARK / WATER skills spin a vortex and FIRE / EARTH / LIGHT / LIGHTNING ones call down a meteor shower. Big hits throw debris that falls back down.

title: Battle graphics upgrade
body:
Battles look richer: every unit is now lit by the map's own light (warm on lava, cool on ice and sea, golden in Asgard) with a soft rim light and shaded edges, and stands on a soft contact shadow.
The battle backdrop slowly drifts like a living camera, and bright maps get gentle light shafts.
'Reduce effects' in Settings keeps things calmer.

title: Photo Studio
body:
Compose your own pictures! Choose any hero you own and any unlocked outfit, pick a map as the backdrop, drag and pinch to pose her, flip, add your Companion, a filter (Warm, Cool, Night, Sepia, Dreamy, Mono, Vivid) and a frame (Gold, Polaroid, Film, Hearts) plus a caption.
Press SNAP — photos go into your album (30 slots), and on the web version you can download them.
Find it in MENU → Heroes & Bond.

title: 2.5D Live for every foe too
body:
Every enemy illustration now has 2.5D depth as well — in the Bestiary (all forms), the World Boss, Boss Hunt, Guild Raid and story scenes.
Corrupted, Mirror, Hollow, Echo, Ashen and Feral foes keep their special look while tilting in 2.5D.
Also live now: the Victory MVP art, event banners, the upgrade celebration and the Gallery viewer.

title: 2.5D Live for every hero
body:
Every hero illustration now has real depth: she tilts toward your finger (or mouse), the light moves across her as she turns, and she breathes softly.
Glytta's evolved outfit keeps her special full rig (blinking, construct, glowing eye).
On a slower phone? Turn it off in Settings → '2.5D Live art'.

title: Arc 9: The Wild Hunt
body:
A horn sounds across the Outlands, and every tamed beast's eyes turn green. Follow Luby through four new chapters — Howling Wilds, Serpent Springs, The Puppet Fair and The Last Hunt — and face the FERAL foes.
New Interlude 'Bath Night for Beasts' after the arc, and a 'Clear Arc 9' mission (16,000 Gems, 30 Summon Tickets, 7 Celestial Gems).
Fixed: mirror / hollow / echo / ashen characters in story scenes show their special look again.

title: Companion Assist & Bond Stories
body:
Your Companion now joins the fight! At the start of Round 2 she dashes in and strikes every enemy (stronger with each Bond level) and adds her own skill effect: Burn, DEF down, Stun or Silence.
Every tamed foe also has 3 Bond Stories (Bond 3 / 6 / 10) in the Bestiary — read them for gems, gold and a Celestial Gem.

title: Companions
body:
Choose one tamed foe as your COMPANION in the Bestiary (Taming tab).
She sits beside your secretary in the lobby (tap her for a line and a head-pat), cheers from the corner of every battle, and gives the whole team +0.5% ATK/HP per Bond level (up to +5%).

title: Taming, new Gallery & cleaner art
body:
TAMING: defeat a foe 20 times and you can tame her in the Bestiary. Talk every day, rub her head for pats and give gifts to raise her Bond, unlocking her evolved forms and rewards.
Bestiary now shows every form (level-ups and evolutions) of each foe. Pinch to zoom on hero and bestiary art; tap still plays a reaction.
Gallery: one card per hero, sorted SSR → SR → R; tap a hero to open her album of outfits and evolutions. Hero list now shows 6 per row with bigger art.
Character art was re-cut from the originals: no more missing heads, see-through bodies or white boxes.

title: 2.5D Live: Glytta
body:
Glytta's evolved outfit is now fully 2.5D! She has real depth: tilt her by touching (or hovering on PC), and watch her breathe, blink and pant while her living construct writhes, its blue fire and great eye pulsing.
Set her as your secretary to see it in the lobby.

title: The Oath Ceremony
body:
Swearing an Oath is now a full ceremony: a heavenly hall under falling petals, the Oath Ring rising in a beam of light, and your partner revealed in her Oath outfit.
The date of your Oath is remembered forever on her Bond page, and you can replay the ceremony any time.

title: SSR Ultimates & hero gestures
body:
Every SSR hero now unleashes a full-screen ULTIMATE cinematic the first time she uses her skill in a battle: speed lines, her full illustration and the skill name slamming in.
Hero page gestures: rub her head for head-pats (+Bond), long-press for a close-up, swipe left/right to flip through your heroes.
Tip: turn off cut-ins in Settings if you prefer fast battles.

title: Luby joins + 5 new foes
body:
Luby, the Mecha-Cat troublemaker, arrives with her own rate-up banner and the special skin 'Plush Panther Purr' in the Wardrobe!
New enemies Scomantis, Skelinch, Serpentia, Voodoo Doll and Liza Morph now prowl the story, events, the Starlight Rift and the World Boss rotation.

title: A brand-new Summon experience
body:
The Aether Gate now opens under a sky full of stars, with twin glowing circles and gathering light.
Cards arrive with ornate backs — watch for a purple glow (SR) or a golden glow (SSR) before they turn!
SSR heroes enter in a burst of light, golden rays and sparkles.

title: Livelier battles & lobby gestures
body:
Battle: defeated units now burn away in the attacker's element colour, heroes crouch before they strike, and the last enemy falls with a slow-motion FINISH!
Lobby gestures: rub your secretary's head for a head-pat, press and hold for a close-up, and swipe left/right to change secretary.

title: Special Skins & the Wardrobe
body:
Exclusive outfits arrive: Golden Jackpot (Ning Er) and Scarlet Overdrive (Spimei).
Unlock them in the WARDROBE with a Skin Ticket or Gems — every special skin gives +10% ATK & HP, and golden sparkles in the lobby.
A free Skin Ticket is waiting in your Mailbox!

title: Tidier menus + Commander Road
body:
The MENU is now grouped into Battle, Events, Heroes & Bond and Shop & Social — and scrolls like a gallery.
Event and Festival moved into the MENU and the lobby banner, so the lobby is cleaner.
New in Missions: COMMANDER ROAD — rewards every 5 Commander levels, grand rewards every 25!

title: Dates are here!
body:
Take any hero with Bond 3+ on a date: a forest picnic, the poolside resort, a moonlit onsen, the night market, the starport or the crown of Yggdrasil.
Answer the way she likes best for a PERFECT DATE and a golden photo in your Date Album. Two dates per day.

title: Arc 8: The Gilded Gate + Bestiary
body:
A golden gate cracks open above Asgard. Meet Angela, Ning Er, Mei, Kara and Spimei in their own story — and face Hairly, Svormentis, Ymir and a heartless Mirror Spimei.
New: the Bestiary (Menu). Every enemy you defeat is recorded; kill milestones give Gems, Summon Tickets and Celestial Gems.

title: New faces in the Shop: Grafity & Hairly
body:
Grafity now runs the Friend Shop — she's definitely NOT happy to see you. Watch her spirit flames flicker.
Hairly the oracle runs the Arena Shop.
All four shopkeepers are animated and react when you tap their head, body or legs.

title: 5 new heroes + Special Event banners
body:
Welcome Angela (Seraphic Valkyrie), Kara (Phoenix Reaper), Mei (Crimson Blade Bunny), Ning Er (Princess of a Thousand Coins) and Spimei (Scarlet Spider Engine)!
New foes Hairly, Svormentis and Ymir appear in story, events, Rift and World Boss.
Tap Mei's Special Event banner to watch her animate. Visit Hairly's Fortune in the lobby once a day!

title: Limited events now rotate every 2 weeks
body:
Five limited events take turns: Moonlit Festival (Lumeira), Primeval Safari (Atalanta), Necro Masquerade (Vexira), Starport Gala (Gemora) and Dragonbone Trials (Zennyo).
Each has its own story, stages and featured-hero exchange.
Merchant Lulu in the Shop is animated now too!

title: Lulu comes alive at the Black Market
body:
Night Shift Lulu now breathes, blinks, sways and talks — with new voice lines.
Try tapping her head, body or legs... she has an opinion about each.
She also runs the Hunter's Exchange.

title: A brand-new look + Secretary Moments
body:
Every menu has a new ornate frame, glossy buttons and rarity card frames.
Lists now scroll like a phone gallery — drag anywhere, even on cards.
New HOME button on every screen.
Tap the pulsing heart beside your lobby hero once a day for a Secretary Moment!

title: Arc 7: Ashes of Abaddon
body:
Abadonia's lost kingdom awaits. Four new chapters, the ASHEN bosses, and Interlude 7 "Lion's Onsen".
New Boss Hunt targets: Cinder Witch of Dragonbone (Star Stones) and Outland Leviathan (extra Hunt Cores).

title: Private Room is open!
body:
Invite your favourite hero to the Commander's Room, a cozy bedroom, the onsen and more.
Talk, give gifts and rest together. Each hero has a favourite room where Bond doubles.

title: Harvest Lantern Festival
body: All of November! Earn Lantern Charms from battles, make a free wish every day and trade for Furu & Rumi shards.

title: Starlight Rift & Limit Break
body:
Climb the weekly roguelite Rift and choose Blessings after every floor.
6-star heroes can now Limit Break up to Lv.100 using Hunt Cores.

title: Welcome to Euphoria Online
body: Thank you for playing! Online features (real players in Arena, Guild and rankings) are coming soon — until then, rivals marked [AI] keep you company.
